summary: DESIGN-036 defers its last acceptance criterion to QA-007 in prose only: 'Complete authenticated 200% zoom and show-day mobile review under QA-007.' No handoff linked the two, so the deferral was untrackable. This handoff makes it concrete. It also carries the honest status of the task: 6 of the 8 pattern families its goal names are delivered and test-guarded, and navigation and scope are NOT, because both live under components/admin/** which the design-system grant excludes in this wave.
completed: Established the exact status of the reusable pattern set from disk: 8 files in components/admin/logistics/command-center (attention-row, error-state, states, status-indicators, summary-stat, types, logistics-overview-panel, index barrel) exporting attention, readiness, source-health, summary, loading, empty, error and the overview panel.

Established that the pattern test is a real guard rather than a snapshot: 5 tests asserting accessible names, roles, aria-busy, a clamped percentage (140 -> 100), a real href, and an onRetry invocation. npx vitest run on it passed 1 file / 5 tests on 2026-09-25.
Wrote DESIGN-036's acceptance criteria down for the first time, which is what surfaced the gap.
what_qa_is_asked_to_produce: An authenticated 200% browser-zoom pass over the logistics Overview that exercises the reusable set: no clipped readiness percentage, no truncated attention reason, no overlap between the scope bar and the command-center content, and no loss of the action affordance on an attention row.

A show-day mobile pass: attention rows remain readable and tappable, the source-health summary stays legible at mobile width, and the loading/empty/error states do not shift the layout when they swap.
A keyboard pass over the same surfaces, since the attention row's action is a link and the error state's retry is a button.
A verdict per pattern family, so a failure names the pattern rather than the page.
known_gap_qa_should_not_be_asked_to_cove: NAVIGATION AND SCOPE PATTERNS DO NOT EXIST in the reusable set. components/admin/logistics/logistics-scope-bar.tsx is a one-off admin-lane file outside the set, unexported from the barrel and untested, and it is currently modified in the worktree. There is no navigation primitive at all. QA cannot review a pattern that has not been written, so these two are an implementation gap for the admin lane / orchestrator grant, recorded on DESIGN-036 and not on QA-007.
next_steps: Fold the 200% zoom and show-day mobile journeys into QA-007's existing authenticated logistics pass, or accept this handoff as its own scoped record; either way, record the evidence against DESIGN-036's last acceptance criterion.
